parties.respondent: The State of Madhya Pradesh & Ors.

summary: Quasi-judicial order vs departmental proceedings; delay of 14 years in chargesheet issuance; no allegations of extraneous influence, bribery, or gratification; K.K. Dhawan exceptions examined; mere legal error insufficient for disciplinary action; Virendra Kumar Singh and Zunjarrao Nagarkar precedents applied; delay unexplained and excessive; disciplinary proceedings quashed due to inordinate delay and absence of misconduct evidence.
legal_provisions_cited: Madhya Pradesh Land Revenue Code, 1959 s.57(2)
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; disciplinary proceedings quashed; chargesheet invalidated due to inordinate delay and lack of misconduct allegations.
